programs.title: Dodo Heroes
programs.desc: Inspiring stories about animals in need and the people who help them.Each episode highlights deep bonds between various representatives of the animal world and the people who save and care for them.In the program, viewers meet a former British Marine officer, Pen Farthing, who organized the adoption of over 700 stray dogs by soldiers serving in Afghanistan.They will also see an Australian family saving baby koalas.Animals need help after being hit by winter cyclones.Another extraordinary man in the program will be Derrick Campana, who creates prosthetics tailored specifically to the individual needs of animals, helping everyone from elephants to rabbits.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern begins another culinary adventure, during which he will again taste the strangest dishes in the world, from wild goat to duck liver.In the new season of the show, Andrew will taste snake eggs in Japan and drink snake bile in Shanghai.In Okinawa, people eat pickled pig's ear, poisonous urchin fish and tuna eye.Finally, he will go to China to try turtle, chicken hearts and snail shells.Viewers will find out whether Andrew will survive such a difficult test.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off on another journey around the United States.Together with cameraman Bebek, he will lie on the beaches in Miami, see historic plantations in Georgia and party in the clubs of New Orleans.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: New Orleans is known as the most haunted city in America.You can feel magic in the air, and you can meet fairies and witches on the streets.Marcin will take advantage of the prophecy of a local soothsayer and learn about his future. He will also meet a real Voodoo Prince!In addition, the host will try local donuts and make some great bigos... In this episode, Marcin will show viewers all the faces of New Orleans.He will visit the partyiest street, Bourbon, dance to jazz music, take part in a spectacular swingers' parade, and even start a party on the ship.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: The fun never stops in New Orleans.This dancing city is, above all, the cradle of jazz - music resounds here from morning to evening, creating an amazing atmosphere, and artists from all over the world hang out in cafes and pubs.Colorful buildings and narrow streets give the city a unique character and thus become an attractive setting for film productions.There is also no shortage of different colors on Frenchmen Street, where Marcin can try on an original suit.Also expect a bit of poetry on the way to Miami!However, before we get there, Marcin will have to find his black, mechanical horse...
